description: This file defines the abstract class SuperNode, which represents a node in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) that can have child nodes. It includes methods for managing children, accepting visitors, and overriding Object methods like toString, hashCode, and equals.

classes.name: SuperNode
classes.description: An abstract class representing a node in an AST that can have child nodes, providing common structure and behavior for subclasses.

methods.name: SuperNode()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list of child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren()
methods.description: Returns the list of child nodes.

methods.name: accept(final PredicateVisitor predicateVisitor)
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing PredicateVisitor and calls its visit method for this node.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including its children.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the children list.

methods.name: equals(final Object obj)
methods.description: Checks for equality with another SuperNode based on the children list.
